source: in-session Claude Code agent (pred-scout-coach) over data/catalog/heroes.json ability text only; every number ground-checked against the ability, failing lines dropped

wraith.E: Go invisible to escape or reposition; takedowns reset it, so use it after kills.
wraith.LMB: Poke safely from long range and finish low enemies with basic attacks.
wraith.RMB: Snipe marked targets or last-hit minions to refund mana and cut the cooldown sharply.
wraith.Q: Throw it to slow and reveal enemies, then follow with Knock, Knock! for extra damage.
wraith.R: Mark an enemy who just dashed or walked in, then pull them back to where they were.
wraith.Passive: Place your drone in jungle paths and objectives to spot enemies hiding behind walls.

wukong.LMB: Basic attack often to spawn clones, which add extra hits for you.
wukong.RMB: Spirit: dash to slow and engage. Body: push enemies and clones away to peel or reposition.
wukong.Q: Spirit: create a cloud path for your team. Body: leap and gain attack speed for burst trades.
wukong.E: Spirit: spin to reduce damage, then throw to stun. Body: slam the ground for big damage on groups.
wukong.R: Switch stance to fit the moment: Spirit for movement and stuns, Body for damage and pushes.
wukong.Passive: Double jump to escape over walls or dodge abilities; keep it ready for when you get caught.

zinx.LMB: Poke enemies with basic attacks to stack damage over time and charge your passive.
zinx.RMB: Save heals for allies who are low or being focused; it heals more the lower they are.
zinx.Q: Throw it into grouped enemies so it bounces between them, stunning several targets.
zinx.E: Drop it under enemies to slow them, then follow up as it erupts.
zinx.R: Cast it on your carry or a diving ally just before they take lethal damage so they revive.
zinx.Passive: Hit enemy heroes repeatedly to activate it, then use the bonus speed and healing to save allies.

kallari.R: Save it to finish low-health enemies; it does much more to wounded targets.
kallari.LMB: Basic attack after landing your dagger or dash to stack damage before the Death Mark detonates.
kallari.RMB: Use both charges to poke or finish fleeing enemies; it hits minions and monsters extra hard for clearing.
kallari.Q: Go invisible to reach a backline target or escape; stay away from wards and enemy heroes or you'll be revealed.
kallari.E: Dash onto a Death Marked target for double damage, or use the backflip to dodge abilities.
kallari.Passive: Hit a hero to mark them, then burst them before it detonates; extra jumps help you escape over walls.

grim-exe.LMB: Kite and basic attack constantly; your attacks deal magical damage and burst Pulsefire from your abilities.
grim-exe.RMB: Save the shield for the enemy's key stun or burst ability; a successful block also refunds mana.
grim-exe.Q: Fire it after a basic attack to burst Pulsefire; in Assault Mode lob it to knock divers away from you.
grim-exe.E: Stay in Sentry Mode to regain mana and stack attack speed; switch to Assault Mode for long-range sieging and teamfights.
grim-exe.R: Lock on to a low, fleeing hero; keep enemy heroes from standing between you because they can block the orb.
grim-exe.Passive: Alternate basic attacks and abilities so every hit bursts the previous Pulsefire for bonus true damage.

the-fey.LMB: Poke with basic attacks between abilities while staying behind your frontline.
the-fey.RMB: Throw it where enemies will stand longest, like on top of a stunned target or an objective.
the-fey.Q: Lay it in chokepoints or under your team to slow enemies and speed up allies.
the-fey.E: Spam it on the same enemy hero to stack damage; hitting heroes refunds most of its mana.
the-fey.R: Cast it in the middle of grouped enemies, then follow up while they're pulled and stunned.
the-fey.Passive: Use takedowns to chase or reposition, since each spawns an exploding plant and gives speed.

lt-belica.Q: Aim it through enemies to knock up and stun them, then follow with Void Bomb.
lt-belica.LMB: Poke with short bursts between abilities while staying out of the enemy's reach.
lt-belica.RMB: Place it where enemies will stand after your stun; hitting several restores mana.
lt-belica.E: Drop the drone in the lane or at objectives for vision and to drain casters' mana.
lt-belica.R: Use it on a low or mana-drained target to finish them; it also silences briefly.
lt-belica.Passive: Max one ability at a time to unlock its extra effect and gain ability haste.

khaimera.LMB: Keep attacking to build Rage, which makes all your cooldowns recharge faster.
khaimera.RMB: Leap onto low-health targets for extra damage and a slow that keeps them in your reach.
khaimera.Q: Cast it right after landing Ambush; the fast attacks cleave nearby enemies and build Rage quickly.
khaimera.E: Save it to remove stuns and slows when enemies try to lock you down, or to heal mid-fight.
khaimera.R: Use it when several enemies are in front of you to stun them all and refill Rage.
khaimera.Passive: Stay in constant combat; keeping Rage high gives faster cooldowns and movement speed.

gideon.RMB: Aim through minions or a hero to slow them; extra mana makes its cooldown recharge faster.
gideon.Q: Lead your target and aim where they'll stand; it pairs well with a slow or root.
gideon.E: Teleport in to engage or out to escape; allies can follow you through the portal.
gideon.R: Cast in the middle of grouped enemies after they're slowed or rooted; channel the full duration for maximum damage.
gideon.Passive: Always basic attack after an ability hits a hero to tether them and set up a root.
gideon.LMB: Basic attack right after landing an ability to attach the tether, which roots the target after a delay.

drongo.LMB: Kite with basic attacks; critical strikes apply your bleed, so keep hitting the same target.
drongo.RMB: Throw it so it hits terrain early and returns, hitting and slowing enemies twice.
drongo.Q: Toss it on enemies about to cast an ability; the silence stops escapes and combos.
drongo.E: Turn it on before trading, then pop the stacks early with Old Rusty or your ultimate.
drongo.R: Fire into grouped enemies to shred armor, or cast it mid-air to blast yourself away from divers.
drongo.Passive: Spread ability and crit hits across heroes; the bleed scales with their max health, so it shreds tanks.

iggy-scorch.RMB: Throw it onto oil or Slick-covered enemies to ignite them; the fire field zones a choke point.
iggy-scorch.Q: Place turrets ahead of fights or near objectives; hit your target with Spew so they focus it.
iggy-scorch.E: Roll oil under enemies to slow them, then ignite it with Molotov or Inferno for extra damage.
iggy-scorch.R: Walk into the fight while flaming; finish by reactivating to belch and knock divers away.
iggy-scorch.Passive: Always basic attack before your fire abilities land so enemies get ignited for bonus damage.
iggy-scorch.LMB: Basic attack enemies to stack Slick so your fire abilities ignite them, and to redirect turrets onto your target.

steel.LMB: Alternate light and heavy hits; land the heavy hit during trades for the most damage.
steel.RMB: Stun enemies in front of you after charging in; it hurts more against high-health targets.
steel.Q: Charge through enemies to knock them back toward your team; you can't be stopped during the dash.
steel.E: Place the wall between your team and enemy shooters to block projectiles in fights.
steel.R: Leap onto grouped enemies to knock up and stun them for your team to follow.
steel.Passive: Avoid taking damage between fights so your shield refreshes before the next engage.

legion.LMB: Fire in short bursts and pause to let ammo replenish so you don't get stuck reloading mid-fight.
legion.RMB: Cook it briefly to time the explosion on enemies, or throw it at your feet to launch yourself away.
legion.Q: Fire it into a group or reactivate it above enemies to spread mines that slow them.
legion.E: Plant it where your team will fight; it heals allies who stay near and reveals enemy wards.
legion.R: Drop it on grouped enemies or an objective fight; the beam tracks heroes, so it punishes anyone who stays.
legion.Passive: Buy attack speed and plan items around the stat thresholds that power up specific abilities.

boris.Q: Use it to hunt a fleeing or hidden hero; hitting the marked target slows them and gives a free canister.
boris.LMB: Stack basic attacks on heroes and monsters to fill canisters fast; every second hit grants one.
boris.RMB: Dash through enemies to close the gap; both swipes apply on-hit effects, so it also stacks canisters quickly.
boris.E: Cast it as you dive in; hold the barrier longer before it explodes for a longer fear on nearby enemies.
boris.R: Grab the carry or a squishy and slam them into their team; everyone in the landing zone gets slowed.
boris.Passive: Commit to extended fights; at max canisters the Tesseract Core adds damage and healing on every hit.

phase.LMB: Poke safely while linked so your partner gains bonus power from the link.
phase.RMB: Link your carry or main damage dealer; reactivate to pull them back out of danger.
phase.Q: Cast it when enemies face you or your linked ally to blind them, and to lower your blink cooldown.
phase.E: Channel it on an enemy hero long enough to stack the slow into a root.
phase.R: Use it at the start of a big fight so you and your linked ally gain attack speed, haste and speed.
phase.Passive: Keep casting abilities in fights to heal yourself and your linked ally; use blink to escape or reposition.

murdock.LMB: Count your hits; after a streak, your next shot gains a lot of range for safe poke.
murdock.RMB: Fire it up close for full damage and a strong push, perfect for peeling divers off you.
murdock.Q: Place traps in bushes, chokes and escape paths to root anyone walking through.
murdock.E: Turn it on to chase or kite; recast during fights to stack attack speed, and it resets on takedowns.
murdock.R: Fire it across the map to finish fleeing low-health enemies or hit a grouped team in a line.
murdock.Passive: Keep landing basic attacks so your next shot gets extra range and bonus damage.

terra.LMB: Basic attack between abilities to build Hersir stacks quickly.
terra.RMB: Charge it longer for more range and damage; you can't be stopped while channeling, so use it to engage.
terra.Q: Hit heroes with both strikes to refund cooldown; at max Hersir it gets a third strike.
terra.E: Throw it to slow and reduce armor; at max Hersir it roots, so save the empowered throw for catches.
terra.R: Use it to dive under enemy towers or remove stuns; it disables towers and makes you very tanky.
terra.Passive: Build stacks before using a key ability so it gets empowered, especially Highland Hurl.

skylar.RMB: Turn it on before trading or taking an objective; it turns attack speed into rapid hits that ignore some armor.
skylar.Q: Stick it on the target you want to slow, then keep attacking while it detonates on them and nearby enemies.
skylar.E: Hover to get over divers and gain range, then keep attacking for bonus missiles.
skylar.R: Fire it at a wounded hero with a clear line; it stops on the first hero and hits harder on low targets.
skylar.LMB: Kite with basic attacks, using your extra jump height to stay out of melee reach.
skylar.Passive: Last-hit minions in clumps so the explosions damage the rest of the wave; hero kills blow up much bigger.

kira.RMB: Use it to add Vengeance stacks quickly; it can crit and lifesteal, so weave it into every trade.
kira.LMB: Basic attack to stack Vengeance on one target, then pop it with Dusk for heavy damage.
kira.Q: Stack Vengeance with attacks and Mercy, then cast it to burst and slow everyone marked.
kira.E: Dash to dodge abilities or reposition; it resets on takedowns, so chain it during fights.
kira.R: Use it when enemies are grouped near you; it cuts their healing, so it counters lifesteal and heals.
kira.Passive: Save the empowered shot for a healthy target, since it scales with their current health.

maco.LMB: Poke with basic attacks while staying near your carry, ready to heal or stun.
maco.RMB: Throw it from far away for a longer stun, detonating it early only to catch someone up close.
maco.Q: Lob it on yourself or an ally to heal and speed them up, or hit enemies for poke.
maco.E: Leap onto enemy heroes to slow them and gain a shield, then use the dash to reposition.
maco.R: Charge it and push enemies into your team or a wall to stun everyone in its path.
maco.Passive: Keep moving between fights to build speed and slow immunity, then engage before taking damage.

revenant.LMB: Make your final round count; it always crits, so line it up on the target you want to burst.
revenant.RMB: Reload early when out of fights so you enter the next one with a full magazine.
revenant.Q: Mark a target with Scar first so all the missiles focus them.
revenant.E: Hit your main target, then keep damaging them to consume the marks and root them.
revenant.R: Pull an isolated carry into a duel where their team can't help; kill them inside for bonus gold.
revenant.Passive: Build crit and attack speed for more power, and prioritize kills for bonus gold.

yin.RMB: Push away divers or reflect projectiles back at enemies when they fire at you.
yin.Q: Pull yourself to an enemy to slow them, then leap to a safe spot or keep attacking.
yin.E: Activate it to attack from range and cleave nearby enemies during fights.
yin.R: Use it to block enemy projectiles and slow anyone inside while you fight.
yin.LMB: Keep attacking to build Rising Storm stacks and trigger Windburn's bonus damage on every third hit.
yin.Passive: Attack heroes and monsters constantly to keep max stacks for much faster attacks.

argus.LMB: Poke with basic attacks while your abilities recharge, keeping your distance from melee heroes.
argus.RMB: Hold it on a target in range to keep homing shots flowing; watch your mana early since every blast costs some.
argus.Q: Lob it where the enemy is walking, not where they stand; the stun sets up the rest of your combo.
argus.E: Drop it on enemies to push them apart, or on allies to lift them clear; the implosion then pulls enemies together.
argus.R: Channel from a safe spot after enemies are low; beams hit harder on wounded targets, so finish fights with it.
argus.Passive: Chain abilities quickly on one target; each extra hit stacks Disintegrate, so a full combo deals far more than single spells.

mourn.LMB: Basic attack right after an ability to use your empowered Extract hit, which also heals you.
mourn.RMB: Wind up the vines from cover, then release to pull an enemy into your team; don't hold too long or it cancels.
mourn.Q: Cast it in the thick of a fight so you and allies heal and gain armor while enemies take damage.
mourn.E: Channel longer for a bigger area and longer mesmerize; the damage reduction helps you hold it while diving.
mourn.R: Use it before a team engage or objective fight; blinded enemies can't see your team coming.
mourn.Passive: Weave basic attacks into every trade to heal back health in long fights.

grux.LMB: Stick to one target and keep attacking to stack your bleed to the max.
grux.RMB: Hit enemy heroes or the camp leader to heal; it applies on-hit effects twice, so it hits hard with stacked bleeds.
grux.Q: Charge it longer for extra range and pull an enemy into your team; the stun holds them there.
grux.E: Charge through an enemy hero to drag them toward your team or a tower.
grux.R: Use it when several heroes are close to stun them all, then keep hitting them to steal physical power.
grux.Passive: Commit to extended trades; your bleed grows with every hit, so short pokes waste your strength.

bayle.LMB: Finish full basic attack chains; the third hit deals the most damage, so don't cancel it early.
bayle.RMB: Leap onto enemies to shred their armor, then use the speed boost toward marked targets to stay on them.
bayle.Q: Land all three slashes on one target for the bleed; the final horizontal slash stuns, so line it up through enemies.
bayle.E: Howl when you're in the middle of a fight; the slow, extra power and healing at the end reward staying in.
bayle.R: Charge at an isolated hero; it scales with their max health, so it's great for deleting tanks or a backline carry.
bayle.Passive: When low, keep fighting instead of running; Berserk gives attack speed and tenacity to turn the trade around.

morigesh.LMB: Basic attack Pestilence-afflicted targets to keep the stacking damage refreshed.
morigesh.RMB: Mark the hero you want to kill so your ultimate can find them; last-hit with it to refund cooldown and mana.
morigesh.Q: Throw it on enemies to slow them hard, setting up Swarm or your other abilities.
morigesh.E: Pass through enemy heroes to refresh the effect and heal; use it to engage or escape.
morigesh.R: Cast it on your marked target once they're low; it removes the mark, so time it well.
morigesh.Passive: Spread damaging abilities quickly to stack Pestilence, which scales with their max health.

muriel.LMB: Poke lightly, but prioritize staying alive and keeping your abilities ready for your team.
muriel.RMB: Charge it fully before releasing to stun the first enemy hit; a quick release only slows.
muriel.Q: Place it under your team in fights or near objectives to heal allies and weaken enemy attackers.
muriel.E: Throw it at an ally who is being chased or diving in to give them a shield and speed.
muriel.R: Fly to an ally in danger across the map to shield them and knock up nearby enemies.
muriel.Passive: Hit enemies with damaging abilities to reduce their healing, and buff allies to boost your shields and heals.

greystone.LMB: Basic attack between abilities; your passive deflects a hit regularly, so trading into ranged enemies costs less than it looks.
greystone.RMB: Leap onto heroes or the camp leader to lower its cooldown and gain speed, letting you leap again sooner.
greystone.Q: Drop the whirlwind on enemies early in a fight to shred their armor before your bigger hits land.
greystone.E: Use it for the cleave slow on grouped enemies, or to catch someone just out of normal attack range.
greystone.R: Cast it when low in the middle of enemies; you heal more the lower you are, then crash down for big damage.
greystone.Passive: Stay in fights when hurt; your armor and regeneration grow as your health drops, so you're toughest when low.

rampage.LMB: Basic attack between abilities, especially after Rumble slows enemies so they can't walk away.
rampage.RMB: Leap into enemies to knock them back toward your team, or combine it with a held boulder.
rampage.Q: Throw the boulder at a hero you can reach to stun them; carry it while closing the distance.
rampage.E: Use it often to slow nearby enemies; during Behemoth its cooldown is even shorter.
rampage.R: Activate it before a big fight or when diving many enemies; healing rises with nearby enemy heroes.
rampage.Passive: Stay in the jungle to regenerate faster, and keep fighting after being stunned to heal back.

riktor.Q: Use it after a pull to silence the target and strip their shields.
riktor.LMB: Basic attack right after landing your hook or silence while they can't fight back.
riktor.RMB: Hook a squishy enemy and pull them into your team; it hurts more against high-health targets.
riktor.E: Turn it on when diving in; it shields you and keeps damaging nearby enemies.
riktor.R: Use it on grouped enemies to suppress them; their cooldowns freeze while locked down.
riktor.Passive: Chain your stuns and silences on key heroes to stop their cooldowns from recovering.

sevarog.LMB: Basic attack between abilities while waiting for Siphon to come back up.
sevarog.RMB: Dash through enemies to fear them, then follow with Subjugate or your ultimate.
sevarog.Q: Use it often on minions and heroes; killing enemies with it builds souls for tankiness.
sevarog.E: Chain enemies to the zone; if they try to leave they get stunned, so place it to cut off escapes.
sevarog.R: Knock enemies back toward your team or into a wall; at max rank it executes minions for wave clear.
sevarog.Passive: Last-hit minions with abilities to stack souls; more souls give health and new effects.

shinbi.RMB: Use both charges to dash through enemies or escape; save one for safety.
shinbi.Q: Fire it through enemies often; it's your main poke and adds Track stacks quickly.
shinbi.E: Cast it as you dive in to gain a shield, speed and wolf damage around you.
shinbi.R: Build max Track by hitting heroes with abilities, then cast it to unleash the pack on marked enemies.
shinbi.Passive: Time your empowered basic attack on heroes for big damage, Track stacks and mana back.
shinbi.LMB: Weave basic attacks between abilities; the empowered hit adds Track and restores mana.

kwang.RMB: Use it while holding the blade for a shield in trades, or near the thrown blade for heavy true damage.
kwang.Q: Throw the blade to tether enemies to it, then dash or teleport to the blade to follow up.
kwang.E: Dash through enemies and pass near your thrown blade to recall it, knocking up everyone nearby.
kwang.R: Throw the blade at enemies first, then teleport to it with your ultimate to slow the whole group.
kwang.Passive: Hit with abilities to energize your blade, then follow with basic attacks for extra lightning damage.
kwang.LMB: Basic attack after every ability while energized for faster attacks and bonus lightning damage.

twinblast.LMB: Weave basic attacks after every ability to fire the triple shot from your passive.
twinblast.RMB: Use both charges to slow and poke; it pairs well with Vaporize on the same target.
twinblast.Q: Fire it through multiple enemies; it applies on-hit effects strongly, so it hits hard with on-hit items.
twinblast.E: Save the dash to escape divers; hitting heroes shortens its cooldown, so keep attacking.
twinblast.R: Unleash it when you're safe and enemies are in range; attack speed adds more bullets.
twinblast.Passive: Always basic attack after an ability for the triple shot and bonus attack speed.

aurora.LMB: Basic attack between abilities; each hit adds magic damage and helps build toward your Frost Storm.
aurora.RMB: Cast it to slow enemies, then hold them inside the cone so the delayed eruption also lands.
aurora.Q: Dash in and cut off escapes with the ice wall, or stop early with Hoarfrost to root enemies right where you land.
aurora.E: Use it the moment you land next to enemies; touching the ring roots them so your team can follow up.
aurora.R: Cast on a grouped enemy team after a root or slow; the delayed stun and explosion punish anyone clumped together.
aurora.Passive: Jump in the air to escape or reposition; the replica draws tower aggro, so use it to dive safely.

dekker.E: Trap a hero inside the fence with your team, or block divers from reaching your carry.
dekker.LMB: Poke safely with basic attacks while staying behind your carry, ready to peel.
dekker.RMB: Bank it off walls to reach targets; longer flights stun longer, so throw it from range when you can.
dekker.Q: Fire it through enemies to slow them so your team can follow up or escape.
dekker.R: Aim the center on a trapped or stunned enemy for a stun; everyone else hit is slowed.
dekker.Passive: Jump in the air to boost nearby allies' movement speed when engaging or escaping together.

akeron.LMB: Keep basic attacking enemies and minions between abilities to build Hunger stacks toward your Awakened state.
akeron.RMB: Cast it up close for bonus damage and a bigger heal; save it to finish a hero so you become Awakened.
akeron.Q: Launch the Eye toward enemies, then refire to pause it on top of them so the fireballs keep slowing.
akeron.E: Web a hero to root them, or lash to a wall and leap down onto a group to knock up and stun.
akeron.R: Pull enemies in, then bite a low-health hero to execute them; each execute permanently raises your maximum health.
akeron.Passive: Stay in the fight trading hits; at max stacks you become Awakened, gaining damage reduction and stronger basic abilities.

renna.LMB: Poke between abilities and collect Essence from nearby kills to power up your kit.
renna.RMB: Fire through minions and heroes to clear waves and poke; more Essence means more projectiles.
renna.Q: Deploy it on low-health enemies; the orb pulls them in and can execute.
renna.E: Hover and launch it at the enemy you want to lock down; the mesmerize sets up your other abilities.
renna.R: Teleport into a fight or onto an objective after enemies are slowed or mesmerized.
renna.Passive: Walk over Essence after every kill to strengthen your abilities; hover by jumping in air to dodge.

gadget.RMB: Stop the droid over a hero so it follows them; great for zoning and wave clear.
gadget.Q: Stick a mine on a hero, then basic attack them before it explodes to empower the damage.
gadget.E: Throw it between you and divers to root them, or have allies walk through for a speed boost.
gadget.R: Cast it on grouped enemies who can't escape easily; it grows and slows, so stand inside it and keep fighting.
gadget.Passive: Hit heroes with abilities and take kills often; stacks permanently raise your magical power.
gadget.LMB: Basic attack heroes carrying your sticky mine to empower it for a much bigger explosion.

adele.LMB: Weave basic attacks between abilities; the bonus true damage keeps hurting tanks, so trade often once your abilities are on cooldown.
adele.RMB: Aim through the enemy you want to catch; hitting a hero roots them and dashes you to the furthest target hit.
adele.Q: Use it right after you land next to enemies: the speed boost keeps you on them and the mesmerize stops their escape.
adele.E: Pop it the moment you dive in or get focused; it works mid-ability, and the vine punishes enemies who stay close.
adele.R: Leap into the middle of grouped enemies; it interrupts channels and roots, then the thornbush slows anyone trying to walk out.
adele.Passive: Hit your main target early in every fight so your teammates deal bonus true damage to them while the mark lasts.

zarus.LMB: Basic attack heroes and monsters to build Gladiator stacks for more physical power.
zarus.RMB: Throw it to finish low targets for big damage; a quick thrust refunds much of the cooldown.
zarus.Q: Raise the shield to block big damage, then swing it to stun enemies in front of you.
zarus.E: Dash in or out of fights; the attack speed boost helps you burst a target after.
zarus.R: Leap onto an isolated hero and kill them inside the Coliseum to gain permanent power.
zarus.Passive: Keep fighting to hold max stacks, then step out briefly to regain health as they fall off.

crunch.RMB: Dash in to stun and start the fight; empower it to travel farther and push heroes toward your team.
crunch.Q: Your main trading hit; empower it for true damage on all targets when fighting tanky enemies.
crunch.E: Jab to slow enemies around you; empower it for a knock-up when you need to lock someone down.
crunch.R: Recast your best ability right away, like an empowered knock-up or dash; the passive heal keeps you alive in long fights.
crunch.Passive: Use two basic abilities to build Turbo, then spend it on the ability that fits the moment.
crunch.LMB: After every ability, land a basic attack to cash in the bonus damage and shave time off your cooldowns.

serath.LMB: Basic attack between abilities; Chastise resets your attack, so weave them together.
serath.RMB: Cast it after a basic attack to reset your swing and slow enemies in front of you.
serath.Q: Mark a key target to vanish and strike around them repeatedly; extra damage on monsters makes it great for clearing camps.
serath.E: Rise up, pick a target from range, and dive onto them to start a fight.
serath.R: Activate it in fights for speed and true damage on every basic attack.
serath.Passive: Grab the demonic visage after takedowns to activate Heresy for free and reset your basic abilities.

sparrow.Q: Drop it on grouped enemies or anyone chasing you to slow and damage them over time.
sparrow.E: Vanish to dodge an engage or reposition, then use the attack speed boost to burn your target.
sparrow.R: Fire from a safe spot at grouped enemies; the arrows pierce, so aim the center volley at the main target.
sparrow.LMB: Keep attacking the same target to stack Relentless for bonus damage based on their max health.
sparrow.RMB: Charge it fully and fire through walls or lines of enemies; stack Relentless first for more damage.
sparrow.Passive: Focus one target with basic attacks and abilities to keep stacks up for steady extra damage.

yurei.RMB: Throw it to apply Soul Rip, then dash through the target with Severance to reset it.
yurei.Q: Kick enemies near you to apply Soul Rip and heal; cast it in the air to leap away.
yurei.E: Dash through targets with Soul Rip to reset its cooldown and rip their soul out.
yurei.R: Channel in the middle of enemies to apply Soul Rip, then pull them in and finish with Severance.
yurei.Passive: Use abilities often so your next basic attacks gain range and bounce to nearby enemies.
yurei.LMB: Basic attack after every ability to fire the bouncing ranged hits from your passive.

feng-mao.LMB: Weave basic attacks between abilities, especially while Hamstring slows your target.
feng-mao.RMB: Dash in to start a fight; after a takedown its cooldown drops sharply, so chain it into the next target.
feng-mao.Q: Hold the spellshield for the enemy's key stun or slow; blocking it doubles your passive bonus stats.
feng-mao.E: Use it when only one enemy is near you for bigger hits, and to slow them as you chase.
feng-mao.R: Save it until enemies drop low enough to execute; an execute lets you recast it for free on another target.
feng-mao.Passive: Get takedowns on different heroes early; each milestone permanently raises your armor penetration.

narbash.E: Toggle healing in lane trades and speed when rotating or chasing.
narbash.LMB: Poke between abilities, but focus on keeping allies healed and stunning enemies who dive.
narbash.RMB: Throw it at enemies near walls or your team; it knocks back and stuns.
narbash.Q: Use it to chase, escape, or heal your team during long fights.
narbash.R: Channel it in the middle of enemies; staying close stacks the slow into a mesmerize and a final knock-up.
narbash.Passive: Fight near many heroes to gain more power and armor; teamfights are where you shine.

eden.LMB: Use ranged stance to poke safely and melee stance to commit once your target is slowed or low.
eden.RMB: In ranged stance reposition and fire the empowered shot; in melee stance dash onto a target to slow them.
eden.Q: Ranged: line up the laser through several enemies. Melee: stay on target through the spins so the final strike lands.
eden.E: Swap stances freely: ranged for poke and safety, melee to heal from damage dealt to heroes.
eden.R: Only usable after overheating; use ranged beams on grouped foes, or melee strikes to finish a single target.
eden.Passive: Keep damaging heroes to build Heat without pausing; Heat decays if you stop, so commit once close to Overheat.

neon.LMB: Basic attack right after dashing to fire the empowered explosion and slow nearby enemies.
neon.RMB: Dash to reposition, then hit an enemy with your empowered shot; when Overclocked recast it for another dash.
neon.Q: Send it through enemies so it hits them on the way out and back, especially when Overclocked.
neon.E: Lob it on grouped enemies to slow; Overclocked, it also mesmerizes, so save it for a key catch.
neon.R: Activate before a fight to Overclock all your abilities, then recast to finish with the bomb.
neon.Passive: Cycle three abilities quickly, then use your next one Overclocked for the strongest effect.

countess.Passive: Land two abilities on the same hero quickly to apply the bleed and gain movement speed to chase.
countess.LMB: Weave basic attacks between abilities while trading, especially once your combo is on cooldown.
countess.RMB: Spin in the middle of enemy heroes; the heal is much stronger against heroes, so use it to win close fights.
countess.Q: Dash in to slow and engage, then re-trigger to swap back to your shadow when the fight turns bad.
countess.E: Throw it down a lane or through a group for long-range damage; it's your main poke and wave clear.
countess.R: Use it on a target already bleeding from your passive for bonus damage and a full heal from the hit.

howitzer.Passive: Use an ability, then basic attack a hero right away to fire the empowered shot and refill mana.
howitzer.LMB: Poke between abilities; your empowered basic attack refunds mana, so hit heroes with it whenever it's ready.
howitzer.RMB: Throw the bombs where enemies must walk, like chokes or around a wounded target, to slow and zone them.
howitzer.Q: Charge it fully for max damage when enemies are slowed or stunned; fire quickly only to finish someone.
howitzer.E: Use it to stun divers, or detonate it under yourself to blast you out of danger.
howitzer.R: Rise up when enemies are grouped or trapped, then paint targets and keep moving to stay safe.

ikra.LMB: Poke with basic attacks and use them to pop your bubble at the right moment.
ikra.RMB: Use it to last-hit minions for bonus gold, or to pop your bubble from range.
ikra.Q: Throw it through minions at a hero; it suspends them, setting up your bubble and ultimate.
ikra.E: Place it on enemies and wait for it to amplify before popping it for much more damage.
ikra.R: It goes through walls, so fire it at enemies fighting behind terrain or chasing your team.
ikra.Passive: Pick your Eternal with your playstyle in mind; each category changes which ability gets stronger.

scarlett.LMB: Finish your chain; the third strike restores energy, especially against heroes.
scarlett.RMB: Use it while moving fast to twirl farther, then stab low targets for bonus damage.
scarlett.Q: Land the outer edge on heroes to slow them and empower your next attacks.
scarlett.E: Dash through enemies to engage and shield yourself; hitting more targets refreshes the shield.
scarlett.R: Restrain the enemy you want to kill, then slam down while becoming unstoppable.
scarlett.Passive: Watch your energy; get takedowns to restore it and keep your combo flowing.

valmont.LMB: Basic attack often; each hit makes Lilith strike too, so faster attacks mean more extra damage.
valmont.RMB: Bind an enemy to slow them and steal attack speed; stay in line of sight so the bind holds.
valmont.Q: Launch the blades at a group or slowed target; each one explodes in a small area.
valmont.E: Hit an enemy with Lilith before trading to gain attack speed for your basic attacks.
valmont.R: Turn it on during long trades to heal from hitting heroes; turn it off when done, since mana cost rises.
valmont.Passive: Stack attack speed so Lilith strikes faster, and take kills to heal from consumed souls.
